statistical_interpretation_scan.coverage: 11/11 reviewed for the descriptive baseline and proposed use
statistical_interpretation_scan.simpson_paradox: Keep country, source and project type disaggregated; do not claim a uniform within-industry change from a pooled fact. The previous restricted common-sector check is supplementary, not proof against every aggregation effect.
statistical_interpretation_scan.ecological_fallacy: Country-industry MP persistence and project New are not enterprise survival or first entry.
statistical_interpretation_scan.berkson_selection: Limit claims to delivered Manufacturing records and separately flag disclosure-selected MP targets; coverage completeness is not established by successful arithmetic.
statistical_interpretation_scan.collider_bias: No causal regression or new conditioning on successful opening; all project statuses remain in the descriptive sample.
statistical_interpretation_scan.base_rate_neglect: Present counts and period denominators alongside shares; show level and share responses separately.
statistical_interpretation_scan.regression_to_mean: Stages are fixed by calendar periods, not chosen for extreme outcome values; no causal improvement claim.
statistical_interpretation_scan.survivorship: Do not condition project facts on eventual opening; do not interpret suppressed BEA observations as zeros.
statistical_interpretation_scan.look_elsewhere: Retain all three destination countries and all three proposed pilot industries, including incompatible or suppressed cells; no significance selection.
statistical_interpretation_scan.forking_paths: Archive the prior facts unchanged, record the new stage definitions and keep January-September comparisons separate from full years.
statistical_interpretation_scan.correlation_causation: Stages describe timing; neither pre/post differences nor stable signs identify trade-policy or pandemic effects.
statistical_interpretation_scan.reverse_causality: No causal direction is assigned to project activity, trade changes or production changes at this stage.
